summary: First backend testing iteration for I-Showed-Up. All 21 review scenarios passed end-to-end against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview against the restored test_database. Admin auth, presence, office config (GET/PUT/regenerate-qr), full member CRUD, geo-toggle check-in & check-out using office coords, attendance status, leaves (member create + admin approve), admin summary, phone login -> admin approval -> status flow, hours report (JSON + CSV + PDF) and members import-template (xlsx) all verified. Test data was cleaned up: post-test DB has 1 user (admin), 1 config (office), 6 leaves (original), 1 attendance (original), 0 devices.

minor.issue: LeaveCreate does not validate that start_date <= end_date or that dates are well-formed YYYY-MM-DD; bad input would silently persist.
Accepts `body: dict = None` instead of a Pydantic model — no schema validation.
Body is fully required (every OfficeConfig field). A partial update (PATCH-style) would be more ergonomic for the admin UI; current shape forces the frontend to send the whole object.

Revoke does not also delete or unset the access_token. Existing device-bound JWTs still pass until the next /auth/me call (which DOES re-check device.status — so OK in practice, just noting the design).

action_items: Optional: split /app/backend/server.py (1333 lines) into modules (auth, office, members, attendance, leaves, reports, devices) — exceeds 700-line guideline.
Optional: add LeaveCreate validators (date format + start<=end).
Optional: replace `body: dict = None` on /api/admin/attendance/toggle/{member_id} with a Pydantic model.
critical_code_review_comments: File length: server.py is 1333 lines — should be split into focused routers/modules.
Phone matching uses last-10-digit key (phone_key) — fine for IN numbers but could cause cross-country collisions in edge cases.
JWT secret in .env is a long placeholder — fine for staging but must be rotated for production.
CORS is wide open (allow_origins=['*'])  with credentials disabled — acceptable for current preview; tighten for prod.
All endpoints exclude MongoDB `_id` via projections — good.
All endpoints under /api/ prefix — good and consistent with ingress routing.
test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (works). Test member test_sailor@iso.app / test1234 was created and DELETED at the end.
seed_data_creation: Created (then deleted) 1 test member, 1 test leave (approved by test), 2 attendance rows (checkin+checkout), 1 phone-login device + 1 auto-generated phone user. All cleaned up via /api/members DELETE + direct Mongo cleanup of leftover device record (no DELETE endpoint for devices exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 scenarios in /app/backend/tests/test_ishowedup_api.py pass cleanly in ~4s. The suite is idempotent: it deletes any prior test_sailor@iso.app before creating, and final cleanup wipes any device/user it created so the demo DB stays at the seeded baseline (1 admin user, 6 leaves, 1 attendance, 1 office config). Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://attendance-portal-56.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_ishowedup_api.py -v`. Frontend was not tested per the review request — that's the next iteration once the user approves the design.
